description: Bitcoin network hashrate (EH/s) with the last 3 daily averages, current difficulty, difficulty-epoch progress and expected change, and miner revenue over the last 144 blocks (about one day): total reward incl. fees in BTC, fee share and average reward per block. Network-wide figures from mempool.space, not per-miner. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_stats when you need Bitcoin mempool congestion from mempool.space: unconfirmed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_bitcoin_hashrate_difficulty
title: Bitcoin network hashrate with the last 3 daily averages
